gameDescriptionHtml:
Mario Kart World is a kart racing game developed by Nintendo EPD and released exclusively for the Nintendo Switch 2. Serving as a launch title for the console, it marks a major evolution for the franchise by replacing isolated tracks with a seamless, interconnected open world. Players can race across diverse regionsвЂ”including bustling cities, grassy plains, deserts, open waters, and volcanoesвЂ”in massive 24-driver competitions that double the racer count of previous entries.

The game introduces expanded movement mechanics and fresh modes built around its open-world design. Drivers can utilize off-roading techniques, rail grinding, wall-riding, and charge jumps to find shortcuts and gain speed. In the reimagined Grand Prix, racers actually drive the highway routes connecting one course to the next between main races. Alongside classic Versus and Battle modes, the game features a new Knockout Tour mode that eliminates trailing players at checkpoints, as well as a Free Roam mode where players can explore freely, complete P-Switch missions, and snap photos.

Beyond its gameplay changes, Mario Kart World boasts the largest roster of new playable characters in series history, turning classic track obstacles like Cow, Goomba, and Cataquack into selectable racers. Players can unlock new karts with coins, earn character costumes through drive-thru meal items, and wield an arsenal of 27 items including the Ice Flower, Hammer, and Mega Mushroom. Supported by dynamic weather, a day-night cycle, and a soundtrack of over 200 arranged tracks, it quickly became the Nintendo Switch 2’s best-selling title.
